sources.gas_phase_basis: Section 2: 99.995% CO2 feed (Table 1), gas-filled apparatus and manometer open to atmosphere. No inert carrier reported; gas above aqueous solution contains CO2 and solvent vapor. Table 3 footnote is total 101.325 kPa, not a CO2 partial pressure. Section 3.2 p.18 models vapor as CO2 + H2O (MDEA neglected by source). Use total bubble pressure including modeled solvent vapor for issue 222 log-ratio comparison; no subtraction of water vapor from the reported pressure.
sources.equilibrium_criterion: Section 2.2 p.16: contact to saturation at spiral-tube exit. Section 4.1 p.20: 2.511 mL/hr selected by preliminary saturation checks; close CO2 inlet when first droplet reaches U-manometer, maintain constant pressure by adjusting mercury height, measure displacement over 20 min (Table 3); average three runs. No quantitative equilibration tolerance or convergence duration criterion reported.
sources.conversion: wt% / 100 = unloaded MDEA mass fraction; no molarity-to-mass conversion. Retain printed alpha, rather than recomputing from rounded mole columns.
